description: Get featured products from a specific fashion brand on Realry.com. Use search_brands first to find the brand_id.

brand_id.description: Brand ID from search_brands result (shown as "Brand ID: `xxx`")

country.description: Two-letter market code deciding shipping availability, prices and currency. Defaults to US when omitted or unrecognised. Pass the shopper's own country — prices and stock differ per market.

name: get_brand_products
title: Brand Products
